description: Query official VA Office of General Counsel (VA OGC) nationwide accreditation registry of 18,660+ recognized claims representatives across all 50 states (DAV, VFW, American Legion, PVA, AMVETS, State Departments of Veterans Services). Resolves official 3-character VA Power of Attorney (POA) codes and verifies accreditation registration numbers.

organization.description: Organization name or acronym (e.g. 'DAV', 'VFW', 'American Legion', 'PVA', 'Georgia Department of Veterans Service')

registration_number.description: Official VA accreditation registration number to validate
